title: Michael Chan
text:
This is Croissant. And yes, he loves butter.
I was born in Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada, where I completed my Bachelor of Science in Biochemistry at the University of Manitoba. I spent the last 10 years working at the National Microbiology Laboratory studying ebola. I am hoping that this program will help me advance my career into the world of biotechnology.

title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
Orientation day on campus.


This first week was great! It’s difficult not having a great time while on a beautiful campus like this.
If you can’t find me, I’ll be at one of the many restaurants on campus. Sushi anyone?
Back to studying!

title: About
text: I grew up in Winnipeg, Manitoba. Before starting the MDS program, I worked at the National Microbiology Laboratory for ten years, where my research focused on the development of diagnostics and countermeasures for high-consequence viruses such as Ebola.

title: About
text:
Why data science
The new frontier of the life sciences lies in harnessing the power of data science to drive scientific discovery and innovation. I am joining the MDS program to build on my scientific background and contribute meaningfully to this evolving field!

title: About
text:
Outside of data science
Cooking is one of my greatest passions. I love exploring new techniques and flavors in my own kitchen. I’m also dedicated to weightlifting and continually refining my technique and approach to fitness.
